name: beatscript
description: BeatScript (btw) for VS Code: highlighting, and through `btwd lsp` diagnostics, quick-fixes, the outline, go to definition, rename, completion, hover, signature help, inlay hints, refactors, and a reference's expansion shown, hidden, copied or ejected.

btw.server.path.description: The btwd binary (it runs `btwd lsp`). Build it with `cargo build --release -p btwd` in stackdump/beatscript.

btw.server.args.description: The arguments the server is started with.

btw.trace.server.description: Log the LSP traffic to the BeatScript output channel.

commands.title: BeatScript: Show or hide the expansion of the reference here
BeatScript: Show or hide every reference's expansion
BeatScript: Open the expansion of the reference here beside
BeatScript: Copy the expansion of the reference here
BeatScript: Eject the reference here into local text
